$comment: Direction: Swift to Rust (protocol 35). Local IPC only. What became of the OS notification for the drift offer in block_id: a delivery fact, never a response. The payload has a block id and one closed channel value and no place a user answer could be carried, so it can never be widened into an outcome the person did not give. Sent when an attempt to post the offer settles; the service timestamps it and answers nothing. notification_posted and alert_style_none mean the notification centre accepted the request (alert_style_none: the person's alert style for Velvt is None, so it is listed in Notification Center and never shown on screen); once either is stored, later reports for the same offer are ignored. Every other channel means nothing was posted, and a later report replaces it.
